context.description: The graph walk finds no stuck state in the release-notes plan (owner ruling 4)

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context re-review after commit 6c46ed46f0 (owner ruling 8, goal.md 2026-10-18: RM19 'within 60 seconds' reads as 'within 180 seconds'). git show 6c46ed46f0 changes only WITHIN_MS 60_000->180_000 (comment cites ruling 8), the walk test title (now 'owner rulings 4 and 8 ... within 180 seconds') and its own timeout 150_000->300_000; LIMIT 5_000, every expect, the walk, the stuck detector and the negative control are unchanged; the file is clean against HEAD. GIVEN the release-notes plan and the engine's progress alphabet: loadPlan('release-notes.spec') goes through the real Blend.load and TaskCommand.plan (6 tasks T1..T1.5, 13 scenarios asserted); the walk's events come from the production TaskAlphabet.alphabet and the key from the production TaskAlphabet.walkKey; the machine is the production TaskMachine.machine(plan), and a separate test asserts TaskMachine.check returns the config unchanged (ruling 4b totality) and the engine's initial snapshot is active. WHEN every state reachable with the canonical interleaving is walked within the bound: the port's getAdjacencyMap walks breadth-first from TaskEngineXState.initial(plan), events filtered to the first unit in document order (ruling 4a), stopWhen done, limit 5_000 (the port fails past it); asserts elapsed < 180_000 ms and edges < LIMIT. THEN no state that is not done lacks an event that changes its key: expect(stuck).toEqual([]), where stuck = non-done states with no transition to another key; the negative control proves the detector (intact example-cascade: 0 stuck; a copy without the blocked rows: stuck states including T1.2 waiting). AND every visited snapshot has status active or done: expect(statuses).toEqual(['active','done']). Non-vacuous: >100 keys, done outcomes exactly budget_exhausted/done/failed/needs_human, and the observed cascade states give T1.5 and T1 blocked. My rerun from packages/opencode (load ~47-63): 3 pass, 0 fail, 26 expect(), walk 338 keys, 746 edges, 54.6 s, file 71.9 s. No gap; the bound change is owner-sanctioned and the deterministic edge guard is unchanged.
